The Order of the Grook#000.src: Talk to Seasum in a tower on {p}.

The Order of the Grook#001.src: Ugh... I really, really, reeeeally don't want to go...
The Order of the Grook#001.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#003.src: Do you... not have manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!
The Order of the Grook#003.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#005.src: Oh, I know! Here, go to my room real fast, and grab the letter in there
The Order of the Grook#005.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#006.src: Bring it back to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.
The Order of the Grook#006.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#007.src: Get the school invitation from Seasum room and bring it to Seasum.

The Order of the Grook#008.src: Yep, that's the right letter. I hope you like school!
The Order of the Grook#008.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#009.src: My parents were super exited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...
The Order of the Grook#009.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#010.src: I don't even want to learn magic! I just want to write my stories and play games. You can go instead.
The Order of the Grook#010.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#011.src: I know the picture on the letter is of me, but you can, um...
The Order of the Grook#011.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#012.src: You can say you had a growth spurt! Uh, that should work, i think!
The Order of the Grook#012.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#013.src: Now go on, you should get out before my parents see you. I don't want them to find out I gave that letter away...
The Order of the Grook#013.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#014.src: Talk to the School Ship Captain on the pier next to the Seaskipper Captain.

The Order of the Grook#015.src: Hey! What are you doing all the way over here? This dock's broken.
The Order of the Grook#015.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#016.src: Oh, a student, you say. Aren't you a little old to be learning fundamental magical knowledge?
The Order of the Grook#016.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#017.src: Well, if I could see your invitation letter, then?
The Order of the Grook#017.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#018.src: ...Hm. This...wow, you really look quite different than the picture. Did you get a new haircut?
The Order of the Grook#018.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#019.src: Well, no judging from me! Keep walking to the end of the dock. Have faith!
The Order of the Grook#019.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#021.src: Alright everyone. Ready for a magical experience?
The Order of the Grook#021.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#022.src: We're headed to the Nexus. You've been told where to go. If you've forgotten, ask your fellow students!
The Order of the Grook#022.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#023.src: If you ever need to come back here, just walk out onto the dock again. Good luck, now!
The Order of the Grook#023.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#024.src: Follow the children to the school.

The Order of the Grook#025.src: Through the wall, right? I hope my uniform doesn't get dirty.
The Order of the Grook#025.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#026.src: Talk to Cidre on the school island.

The Order of the Grook#028.src: Welcome to the island of Grookwarts! I will be guiding and helping all the new students.
The Order of the Grook#028.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#029.src: So all of you will be getting two vouchers each, and with them you will need to buy one wand and a book or tome.
The Order of the Grook#029.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#030.src: You can find everything here around the docks. Choosing your materials is very important, so buy the ones that speak to you!
The Order of the Grook#030.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#031.src: When you're done, meet with Miss Una at the front gates!
The Order of the Grook#031.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#032.src: Purchase a wand from the Wand Merchant and a book from the Magical Book Merchant, then talk to Una.

The Order of the Grook#034.src: Seems like you all have your materials in order. You are now free to enter Grookwarts and begin your lessons.
The Order of the Grook#034.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#035.src: The door is just behind me. Walk on in!
The Order of the Grook#035.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#036.src: Attend the welcoming dinner at Grookwarts.

The Order of the Grook#037.src: Hush, hush! The speech will be soon!
The Order of the Grook#037.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#038.src: Hurry, take a seat! The banquet will be starting any second now!
The Order of the Grook#038.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#039.src: Magical children of Wynn and Gavel alike... We welcome you here, to our fair academy.

The Order of the Grook#040.src: Oh lordy, the headmaster! I didn't even see him come in!
The Order of the Grook#040.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#041.src: Uhm... I don't see him at all, actually...
The Order of the Grook#041.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#042.src: Well, I should hope you can see me now, all of you. Oh, what a splendid turnout this year!
The Order of the Grook#042.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#043.src: Apologies, I simply can't resist a bit of theatrics. But now, it is time to listen and learn, fledgeling Grooks.
The Order of the Grook#043.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#044.src: We knowledged mages and scholars, the Order of the Grook, are pleased to see each of you here. Whether you be a young mind aching with curiosity...
The Order of the Grook#044.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#045.src: ...or an old hat looking to refine their knowledge, all seeking to learn magic are welcomed here. We expect great things of you.
The Order of the Grook#045.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#046.src: Now, to business. You will write your schedules for the semester. Look down on your paper and write in what classes you wish to participate in.
The Order of the Grook#046.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#047.src: You will need to choose four classes, one from each category. The categories are: Elemental Magic, Practical Magic, Magical Creatures, and Types of magic.
The Order of the Grook#047.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#048.src: The schedule book is at the end of the table. Worry not, there is no limit on class size. If you wish to take it, you may take it.
The Order of the Grook#048.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#050.src: Talk to the Ghost Guide and attend your chosen classes (The Ghost Guide will lead you to each class):

The Order of the Grook#051.src: I'll be leading you to your classes, everyone! Talk to me when you're ready to go.
The Order of the Grook#051.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#052.src: Alright, fledgeling Grooks! Your first class is starting in just a minute. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#052.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#053.src: Here are the elemental classes. Step on in. Your magical journey truly begins here!
The Order of the Grook#053.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#054.src: Now, all of you. Sit. Listen.
The Order of the Grook#054.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#055.src: Earth is an element of great power. Versatile and everpresent, nearly as the air.
The Order of the Grook#055.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#056.src: Thunder provides force... Earth provides sheer power. The difference... Force choose its own path. Power is force, directed.
The Order of the Grook#056.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#057.src: Earth is also the earth itself. Stone, metal, trees and soil. Trees sway in the wind, but do not break. And the mountains do not crumble.
The Order of the Grook#057.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#058.src: The Touroto, stepped in earthly magic, are nearly invincible to all but themselves. It is proof of the earth's strength.
The Order of the Grook#058.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#059.src: The Doguns... They were masters of the earth, and fire alike, shaping caverns to their will... And now, nearly extinct. A terrible crime...
The Order of the Grook#059.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#060.src: But we shall honor them, and move forwards. We shall strike the earth and claim it to be our own.
The Order of the Grook#060.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#061.src: The tome directs the earth's force. Take it and utilize it to shatter the stones I summon.
The Order of the Grook#061.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#062.src: The darkest parts of the stones are weak points. Find them, and learn the power of the earth.
The Order of the Grook#062.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#063.src: You know the earth's power, fledgeling. There is nothing more for you here. Go.
The Order of the Grook#063.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#064.src: Hee hee, take your seats, take your seats, TAKE. YOUR. SEATS. A marvelous batch of eager students today!!
The Order of the Grook#064.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#065.src: Almost as marvelous as the powers of Thunder! Energy! Pure, unfocused energy! Devastation, desolation, industrialization all alike!
The Order of the Grook#065.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#066.src: Yes, yes! Thunder is technical and versatile! Unreliable to all those who don't know how to rely on it, to those dexterous of hand and mind!
The Order of the Grook#066.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#067.src: But woe, woe, Thunder is reviled, reviled! Pure energy has no morality! If used for good, yes yes, ho hum, but if used for evil, oh, burn the witch! Burn, burn! Evil, they say! Pah!!
The Order of the Grook#067.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#068.src: All magicks are unaligned with silly concepts such as morality. They are pure chaos! But Thunder, the element of energy and force, it seems ever so EASY to use for evil...
The Order of the Grook#068.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#069.src: And evil has found it, found it! CORRUPTION!! DEMONS!! Forces anathema to us, but knowleged in the ways of force and thus, thunder! So terrible, terrible, and thunder mages feared, feared...
The Order of the Grook#069.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#070.src: And then, then! Joyous day, the Corkians arrived with their marvelous machines, and their electromagic! Thunder controlled, thunder tamed! The wonder of it all!
The Order of the Grook#070.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#071.src: Electromagic makes handles crank, gears spin, metal move, gives sheer stones the power to THINK, and to PLAN! A Corkian original, and a splendid, splendid development reintroduced!
The Order of the Grook#071.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#072.src: And so, you shall see for yourselves! Electromagic at work! You will control thunder and electricity, and make the machines bend to your world today, today, this shocking day!
The Order of the Grook#072.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#073.src: The mechanism is behind me now! Come up, come up! See the power of thunder, shackled by our whims, won't you, ?
The Order of the Grook#073.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#074.src: Whee hee hee! Thunder tamed, thunder shackled, and your magical wings unbound by such petty concepts, ! What a show!
The Order of the Grook#074.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#075.src: Expand your knowledge ever further, further! Your task is complete, complete, and your next awaits!
The Order of the Grook#075.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#076.src: Aah, wow! Everyone s-sure got here quick...
The Order of the Grook#076.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#077.src: Welcome, w-welcome. The Water element class is...certainly an interesting one, I-I'd hope... Because water doesn't j-just pertain to, well, w-water...
The Order of the Grook#077.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#078.src: It also the element o-of knowledge, and pure magicality. Water i-is sort of magical default, If you w-will. If it isn't focused on on o-one element or another, magic ends up being water-based
The Order of the Grook#078.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#079.src: Learning a-about the water element and e-expanding your horizons can allow you to cast spells easier... C-control the flow of magic better, you see.
The Order of the Grook#079.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#080.src: Most aquatic creatures are t-tied to water, though creatures that live in icy or snowy environments are, t-too...often, they are also connected to air, but not always.
The Order of the Grook#080.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#081.src: In a-addition, many holy artifacts are enchanted with water magic... S-something about how it's a pure type of energy, I believe.
The Order of the Grook#081.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#082.src: Lastly, healing abilities are b-bolstered by water magic. Just knowing magic well d-doesn't help, but actually having artifacts charged w-with water magic can increase healing capabilities.
The Order of the Grook#082.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#083.src: N-now, for your test, I have...um, a...a test. Anyone who wants to try it f-first, just go up and start.
The Order of the Grook#083.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#084.src: Good w-work there! I h-hope it wasn't too boring with my talking... You can go now.
The Order of the Grook#084.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#085.src: N-now, who's n-next? And... i-is it really cold in here for all of you, too? Or, is it j-just me?
The Order of the Grook#085.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#086.src: Good to see a decent turnout this year for my class. Too dangerous, pah! You can take this just fine.
The Order of the Grook#086.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#087.src: Anyways. The fire element class. Many misunderstand just what fire stands for... but after today, you will leave with courage in your hearts.
The Order of the Grook#087.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#088.src: Fire is, of course, related to physical fire, magma, etcetera. A burning torch is a source of fire magic, but that is not the only source of it.
The Order of the Grook#088.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#089.src: Courage, bravery, and defensiveness are also tied to the fire element. Those stalwart and selfless, willing to sacrifice themselves for others.
The Order of the Grook#089.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#090.src: In addition, water is tied to healing magic, fire is tied to self-healing. Regenerative capacity if you will. Many fire-based artifacts heal the user passively.
The Order of the Grook#090.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#091.src: And while they are on the verge of extinction after the war in the {p}, the Dogun species used to embody fire and earth magic alike. It is a shame what happened to them.
The Order of the Grook#091.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#092.src: Unfortunately, it is also notable that corrupted creatures are often connected to fire, by nature of the corruption seeming to bring heat wherever it goes...
The Order of the Grook#092.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#093.src: But aside from that, onto our practical test. You will all come up to me, starting with , and hone courage. I will be casting balls of fire at you.
The Order of the Grook#093.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#094.src: You will need to dodge these fire charges. If you are hit, it counts as a failure. Now. Let's get started, .
The Order of the Grook#094.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#095.src: Are you ready? Summon your bravery.
The Order of the Grook#095.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#096.src: Well done , fledgeling Grook! Continue to sharpen your instincts. You'll be a fine hero someday, I am sure of it.
The Order of the Grook#096.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#097.src: Dismissed, . You may leave. Now do I have any volunteers for the next round...?
The Order of the Grook#097.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#098.src: Arright class, the sooner we start, the sooner we finish, so everyone, take your seats! You'll be getting up soon enough anyways!
The Order of the Grook#098.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#099.src: Movin' right along. Air! You're breathing it, we're surrounded by it, but ain'tcha know what it's all about yet, so pay attention.
The Order of the Grook#099.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#100.src: Air is an element of freedom! speed, wind and agility. if you're trained well with agility, attacks'll seem like they just phase through ya!
The Order of the Grook#100.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#101.src: But over and above that, 'cause of air's ever-presence, it's one of the most versatile kinda magic in existence. People use it in all sorts of ways.
The Order of the Grook#101.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#102.src: Over in Gavel, the Bantisu Air Monks have managed to extend their sight by the wind! They use it to help guide folks who get lost in that canyon over there.
The Order of the Grook#102.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#103.src: Many winged sorts a'creatures are tied to air, but not all of them. Some magic users just straight-out float! Now wouldn't that be nice, eh?
The Order of the Grook#103.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#104.src: Due to their tenuous physicality, souls and spirits are also often related to air magic. Make ya wonder if you could just blow ghost out of the window!
The Order of the Grook#104.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#105.src: And finally, some old, old tales tell of a woman who crossed the sea before it was calmed using air magic to fly. 's just an old legend, but an interesting one.
The Order of the Grook#105.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#106.src: Now onto the practical test! It's time to get those bones a-shakin'! You'll be running an obstacle course I have set up, but with a twist.
The Order of the Grook#106.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#107.src: Everyone up to the table! You'll need this feather with ya to get through.It'll help you jump higher!
The Order of the Grook#107.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#108.src: The goal is to grab three crystal balls I put in the obstacle course. once you found 'em, bring 'em back to me.
The Order of the Grook#108.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#109.src: The course is behind me. Shake a leg now!
The Order of the Grook#109.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#110.src: Lessee here, one, two, three, yes indeedy! You got through that pretty quick!
The Order of the Grook#110.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#111.src: Now, if you'll just hand me back that feather ya got there...
The Order of the Grook#111.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#112.src: ...then you'll be all done! Congrats, little fledge, you've finished this class! Now get on along to your next one!
The Order of the Grook#112.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#113.src: Moving swiftly on, the next class is just across the way. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#113.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#114.src: Alright everyone. Take a seat but don't get comfy. You'll be getting up soon. Hope you brought your reading glasses
The Order of the Grook#114.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#115.src: See, I'll just be giving you short primer, then sending you out for the practical exercise, Since I have all this written down already.
The Order of the Grook#115.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#116.src: The basis of this class is that many materials, whether you know it or not, are inherently magical in some way or another. If you want to be artificer, you need to know how each one works.
The Order of the Grook#116.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#117.src: Thankfully, the field of artifice is very popular one, so there's a wealth of knowledge out there on magical materials and how to use them efficiently.
The Order of the Grook#117.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#118.src: Heck, Wynn soldiers are cobbling together rings out of copper and old spider silk, so you know this sort of thing is easy to get to. Tough to master, though!
The Order of the Grook#118.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#119.src: For those intimidated, you don't need much crafting knowledge for this class; you'll be reading up on everything you need to know in the back.
The Order of the Grook#119.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#120.src: You all be crafting a magical amulet using different items. I've stockpiled in the back; everyone will be crafting a different kind of necklace.
The Order of the Grook#120.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#121.src: Here's a note on what you should craft. Once you have the materials you think you need, come to the crafting table. It's enchanted, and will craft the item for you if you have what you need.
The Order of the Grook#121.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#122.src: Mhm, that's the ticket, . If you're interested in learning more, you can probably find my books in most of the libraries.
The Order of the Grook#122.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#123.src: Your feathers are coming out just nicely, fledgeling. You can scoot off to your next class now
The Order of the Grook#123.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#124.src: Okay class, everyone take your seats, and listen up. This class is going to be interesting.
The Order of the Grook#124.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#125.src: As you know, this class is all about magical effects, specifically those tied to various materials, and how they'll affect you!
The Order of the Grook#125.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#126.src: This is going to be a hands-on learning experience, so those of you with weak constitutions may request to skip the demonstration if you're concerned for your health.
The Order of the Grook#126.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#127.src: If you've read my books, you know about Quartz, and how dangerous it can be if overcharged. So, of course, we have overcharged sample so you can feel the signs of it.
The Order of the Grook#127.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#128.src: It may be explosive, but it will be in a controlled manner. The worst that'll happen to you is your face will get a bit dusty, or your glasses will fall off.
The Order of the Grook#128.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#129.src: Magical crystals, as we have to my left here, can be charged with all kinds of different effects. This is an incredibly valuable aspect for artificers.
The Order of the Grook#129.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#130.src: Depending on the formation, they can have natural effects as well. These crystals were found in Gavel's flouting islands, and...well, let's say it's difficult to keep it in its case.
The Order of the Grook#130.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#131.src: Our last sample is of cosmic material, and if you're sickened easily, then don't examine it. Its effects are mostly unknown, but one thing's certain...
The Order of the Grook#131.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#132.src: ...it's dangerous to be exposed for long periods. Now, each of you will go back behind me, and examine and interact with each of the three samples provided.
The Order of the Grook#132.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#133.src: Once you've done so, then you can leave. Hands-on training is the best way to learn, after all.
The Order of the Grook#133.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#134.src: Well done. How did that feel?
The Order of the Grook#134.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#135.src: Personally, the void sample is the most interesting to me. You may now leave the classroom.
The Order of the Grook#135.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#136.src: There's a bit of a walk to your next class. Follow me.
The Order of the Grook#136.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#137.src: These staircases were supposed to move, but... That was too much work to put together, apparently. They're a pain to navigate, aren't they?
The Order of the Grook#137.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#138.src: Alright, fledgeling grooks. Time to hit you all with the info you're really here for!
The Order of the Grook#138.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#139.src: Wybels! Pronounced like nibble, they're a rather popular pet nowadays. But you all knew that, you want to know where they came from.
The Order of the Grook#139.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#140.src: The explanation we got was that they lived in the Ahms region, and when it split open, they eventually burrowed into the surface of the {p}.
The Order of the Grook#140.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#141.src: But no one actually KNOWS for sure. That means they. Could. Be. ANYTHING! What could lie beneath that veneer of fluff and playful demeanor?!
The Order of the Grook#141.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#142.src: Oh, speaking of fluff. The wooly fur never actually stops growing, ever, and neither do their hooves, their horns, or their teeth. They shed often.
The Order of the Grook#142.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#143.src: These materials have innate magical energy to them. Stable like lodestone and reliable like quartz, but not as powerful as either. Interesting, that a fluffball has that potential!!
The Order of the Grook#143.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#144.src: Wybel fluff is also able to be boiled, and it turns into sticky molasses-like substance. It's used for candy, and its very popular...but it's all POISON!!
The Order of the Grook#144.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#145.src: It's POISON, I tell you! Wyble meat is horrendously inedible! It'll give you the worst stomachache of your life! The candymakers are feeding us DEATH!
The Order of the Grook#145.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#146.src: And the worst part is, if too much fluff gathers up in one spot, ANOTHER WYBEL APPEARS! They reproduce by budding!! Growing out of lint and dust! It's a no-win game they're makin' us play!
The Order of the Grook#146.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#147.src: Wybels do have some good use though...they can sniff out sources of cosmic magic, like a pig sniffs out truffles. Sometimes they even try to take it home.
The Order of the Grook#147.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#148.src: It's almost like they miss it, somehow. It's almost like they might be FROM outer space! It's ALMOST like they bringing insanity-inducing things into our houses ON PURPOSE!
The Order of the Grook#148.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#149.src: They're here to kill us all, I swear it! How else would you explain a wybel VAPORIZING a group of poachers? Ten colors of wybel, every one of them rotten evil!
The Order of the Grook#149.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#150.src: Everyone says there's only nine, but WE know the truth! There's a tenth out there, an ultimately powerful one that want us all gone. Pray you never see it, kids.
The Order of the Grook#150.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#151.src: Anyways, my lesson's safe from all that. All you have to do is to re-order these plush Wybel toys on the stand. You'll figure out once you're up here.
The Order of the Grook#151.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#152.src: Alrighty, fledgeling, good job. You're armed with the REAL truth now! Go on to your next class.
The Order of the Grook#152.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#153.src: Hello, students. This is the magical creatures class, and I will be your instructor.
The Order of the Grook#153.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#154.src: Different species have different levels of innate magicality. This is often an invisible aspect of the species. You must never assume.
The Order of the Grook#154.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#155.src: To begin with, Doguns. They are ancient creatures, artificial-seeming at first. Despite this, they are highly adept at earth and fire-based magic.
The Order of the Grook#155.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#156.src: Able to quite literally move mountains, it is theorized that they were the one who carve out the inside of the {p} into the caves we know today.
The Order of the Grook#156.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#157.src: Tales also tell of their utilizing demonic energy for various purposes. However, we are only able to assume their magical energy from Dwarven tales, as they are nigh-extinct
The Order of the Grook#157.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#158.src: Moving on. The term "Greenskins" is a catch-all for Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this definition, though by technicality they are separate.
The Order of the Grook#158.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#159.src: Though many Greenskins societies with mystical particles, the only known way for them to utilize magic is through magical artifacts. They've little magic potential.
The Order of the Grook#159.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#160.src: Meanwhile, Villagers are the opposite persuasion. High magical potential, often unrealized out of laziness.
The Order of the Grook#160.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#161.src: Humans are often thought of as magical then Villagers, due to Fruman soldiers seeming to know some magic innate, but this is untrue.
The Order of the Grook#161.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#162.src: Dwarves have a similar level of magicality to Humans, but like the Villagers, it often go unrealized. Their culture values physical strength more.
The Order of the Grook#162.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#163.src: It is theorized that the reason for this is due to their distance for demonic energies of the Doguns. They reject their magic potential often, such that it is lessening over time.
The Order of the Grook#163.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#164.src: Inversely, Elves have a deep connection to their magicality. Despite their reclusiveness, they are known for their open share of magicality energy within their own society.
The Order of the Grook#164.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#165.src: The outcast Elves of {p} have shared their connection to what we refers to as "The Light". This connection is supposedly unfathomable, but guides them and protects them.
The Order of the Grook#165.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#166.src: Now, we see if you were paying attention. You will come here and order the societies I have referred to in the class from least magical, to the most.
The Order of the Grook#166.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#167.src: Well done, you got it right!
The Order of the Grook#167.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#168.src: Correct. , thank you for paying attention. No one ever seems to in this class. You may go.
The Order of the Grook#168.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#169.src: Next class is actually rather close!
The Order of the Grook#169.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#171.src: ...I was hoping for a smaller class size.
The Order of the Grook#171.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#172.src: Corruption is incredibly dangerous...it'll be tough to keep so many students safe. If anyone wishes to leave, you may.
The Order of the Grook#172.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#173.src: Now... Corruption is a force of nature of...some description. Yes, you heard me right. We don't actually know much about it.
The Order of the Grook#173.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#174.src: Even though it's plagued the Wynn province for a thousand years, the way it behaves is so incredibly alien in nature that it's nigh-impossible to study.
The Order of the Grook#174.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#175.src: We know it raises undead bodies... The working theory is that the more heavily injured a target is, the more susceptible they are to being corrupted.
The Order of the Grook#175.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#176.src: And...well, you can't exactly get more injured than "dead". Hence, the growth of zombies and skeletons and all, over in Wynn.
The Order of the Grook#176.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#177.src: It appears to spread by a complex "root" system. A scientist from {p}, Orikal, has studied this. The corruption spikes appear to spread it in greater concentration.
The Order of the Grook#177.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#178.src: As for the effects on your person, most often paranoia and anger are seen. And that's about the only consistent thing with it; it affect everyone slightly differently.
The Order of the Grook#178.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#179.src: The worst part is that practically everything single thing we've touched on here is conjecture and theorycrafting! The force of corruption is terrifying.
The Order of the Grook#179.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#180.src: The only thing we know for certain is that powerful ice-based magic can halt corruption, as seen in the {p} region.
The Order of the Grook#180.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#181.src: Now, the dangerous part. Everyone, come up past my desk here. We'll examine a corrupted creature in a controlled environment.
The Order of the Grook#181.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#182.src: We have one in captivity, and its cage is reinforced with the strongest metals we have...so dear god let it be enough.
The Order of the Grook#182.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#183.src: Bringing it out now...be sure to back up. We don't want anyone caught in the crossfire here.
The Order of the Grook#183.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#184.src: One thing to note about undead corrupteds...they can't be cured. You can weaken them, but that's about it. ...wait...
The Order of the Grook#184.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#185.src: Wait, why's it spreading here? It's never done this before! E-everyone, back up, now!
The Order of the Grook#185.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#186.src: A-as you can see, corruption is very powerful, eheheh, c-can someone go get another teacher or something?!
The Order of the Grook#186.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#187.src: Wait, no! It's corroding the bars! Everyone, RUN! NOW! GET OUT OF HERE, CLASS DISMISSED!!!
The Order of the Grook#187.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#188.src: GAACK! No, , I said RUN! Don't fight that thing, get OUT!
The Order of the Grook#188.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#189.src: Dear lord...that was awful. , I can't believe you were able to kill that thing!
The Order of the Grook#189.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#190.src: Class absolutely dismissed. We've got to cancel this class...it's far too dangerous for the students...
The Order of the Grook#190.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#191.src: Welcome in, guys and gals... we're learnin' about nature magic today!
The Order of the Grook#191.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#192.src: There's two main ways of usin' nature magic... Shamanism and druidism. Two sides of the same coin, man.
The Order of the Grook#192.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#193.src: Druidic Practices tend to deal with healing more, and nurturing. When life's created, it gives off energy... and Druids use that energy for their magic.
The Order of the Grook#193.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#194.src: Shamanic skills are a lot more direct, man. They take the life from other things and use that to do their stuffs. It's way more varied than Druidic magic.
The Order of the Grook#194.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#195.src: Each has its ups and downs, man. Druidism is chill and helpful... but you can really expand your mind with Shamanism, buddies.
The Order of the Grook#195.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#196.src: Either way, it's all about equivalent exchange, y'see? You can't get somethin' from nothin', man. Either make life or take life.
The Order of the Grook#196.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#197.src: But! It's not peaky about what life you take, man! A good shaman takes from plants and animals, not people!
The Order of the Grook#197.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#198.src: Don't be a Slykaar, kiddos. He asked for human sacrifices, but he lived in a jungle, man! Like, what the hey! He coulda done anything alse!
The Order of the Grook#198.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#199.src: Anyways, our test today, little buds, is to practice some shamanic skills. We got a sick cow in the back, and you're gonna nurse it back to health.
The Order of the Grook#199.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#200.src: You'll need to sacrifice some old grooks, but it has to be just the right amount, man! The practice is through the door behind me.
The Order of the Grook#200.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#201.src: Groovy work, man! You're at one with nature!
The Order of the Grook#201.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#202.src: Your feathers are all grown out, man! Time to head out!
The Order of the Grook#202.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#204.src: That's all four classes! I hope you found them magically enriching! Now, off to the graduation hall!
The Order of the Grook#204.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#205.src: It's the room all the way at the bottom of the stairs. Hurry, don't hold up the ceremony! It won't start until everyone's there.
The Order of the Grook#205.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#206.src: Go to the ceremony room for the Headmaster's closing speech.

The Order of the Grook#207.src: Take a seat. The ceremony is starting.
The Order of the Grook#207.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#208.src: And so, your teachings, or at least their basics, have ended. Your magical feathers have started to grow!
The Order of the Grook#208.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#209.src: You have all been performing very well during your classes today. I've heard quite a bit of praise from the teachers being passed around.
The Order of the Grook#209.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#210.src: But now, for your efforts, you shall not go unrewarded. You will leave here with more than simply knowledge.
The Order of the Grook#210.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#211.src: Your tools have shaped your minds, subtly but inexorably. And so with that, what you leave with today, both in mind and in treasure, shall be different for each of you.
The Order of the Grook#211.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#212.src: Let us start with . Please come up to the stage!
The Order of the Grook#212.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#213.src: There is a reason I've called you up first, you know. Recall what I said about old hats earlier? Don't think we didn't notice the armor, or the weapon, or the grim countenance.
The Order of the Grook#213.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#214.src: But no need to worry. Those who truly have the drive to become learned in the ways of magic, no matter who they are, will always find their way here, and be accepted.
The Order of the Grook#214.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#215.src: A shame about Seasum, but not to worry. Now, hand over your materials, and you'll receive your rewards.
The Order of the Grook#215.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#216.src: And there you have it. Your feathers are grown, and you can spread your magical wings! Good luck on your adventures, Wynn soldier.
The Order of the Grook#216.speaker: Headmaster
